text:
maya: FYI we saw delayed onboarding for ~12 trial tenants created 2026-02-20 -> 2026-02-21. Compiling customer note + mitigation offer.

trent: Can you share which ones are flagged as high-touch?

maya: High-touch: RelayHealth, EchoLab. Full list in doc https://redwood.internal/cs/delayed-onboard-0220

olga: Infra notes: short-lived DB migration left a schema lock that slowed index writer; retries backed up provisioning tasks. Patch pushed and backlog replayed.

ops-bot: deploy: patch/2026-02-22-schema-lock-fix by @olga at 2026-02-22T08:05Z :white_check_mark:

maya: Need decision on credit amount and whether AEs should be looped for renewal-risk. Propose 15% credit + 30m 1:1 for RelayHealth/EchoLab.

trent: 15% seems fine. I'll flag those two in Salesforce and ping AEs.

maya: Olga, can you give a 2-sentence RCA for the email (no heavy internals)?

olga: Draft RCA: "A brief schema lock during an internal maintenance operation caused delays in provisioning for a small number of trial accounts. We resolved the lock, replayed the setup tasks, and verified affected tenants are now provisioned. We've added safeguards to prevent recurrence."

maya: Add apology and the 1:1 offer and I'll send.

reps-team: I'll prepare the outreach template and include the credit mechanics.

maya: Action items: trent  flag in SF + AE ping; reps-team  finalize email + credit details; olga  confirm replay complete and post here.

olga: Replay finished at 2026-02-22T09:10Z. All good.

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll send the email to the impacted list and schedule 1:1s for RelayHealth/EchoLab.
